scope: Six linked supplemental working studies; not additions to the main reader's generated article/search index. Current Gaza evidence is date-scoped. No old ranking inputs or original chat text are changed.

articles.title: The universe might think without being God
articles.subtitle: A correction to the relation between cosmic cognition and the transcendent ground.
articles.summary: Separate a possible physical thinker from the truth on which its existence and its claims depend.

articles.title: Yaldabaoth and Lucifer: two failures of authority
articles.subtitle: Ignorance of a higher standard differs from rebellion against a recognized one.
articles.summary: Develop the two-adversary proposal as a comparison of mistakes about authority, not a diagnosis of ethnic or religious populations.

articles.title: Qumran, Jesus and the ways of life and death
articles.subtitle: A comparison of moral polemic must not turn an opponent's label into an inherited verdict.
articles.summary: Test the proposed connection through specific Qumran, Gospel and rabbinic texts rather than treating Pharisees or their successors as one moral essence.

articles.title: Samaritan inheritance and the limits of a legitimacy claim
articles.subtitle: Historical continuity, sacred place, accepted texts and moral faithfulness can come apart.
articles.summary: Take Samaritan claims seriously without making contemporary wrongdoing decide ancient ancestry.

articles.title: Deliverance, discipline and the test of a sacred command
articles.subtitle: Moses and Jesus illuminate authority that can be corrected; Samuel presents a command that must be faced directly.
articles.summary: Connect Jethro's correction, wilderness discipline, prophetic care and the ethical problem of collective killing.

articles.title: Gaza, hunger and the prophetic test of power
articles.subtitle: Dated humanitarian evidence can sustain a severe critique without turning ancestry into guilt.
articles.summary: Identify present access restrictions and hunger precisely, then ask what a theology of life requires of the authorities controlling relief.
